answer.question: What should I know before requesting turf for a Holly Hills address?
answer.answer: Holly Hills is in unincorporated Arapahoe County even when the mailing address says Denver. Confirm the parcel and applicable county requirements, then bring any property documents to the estimate. Show us the space you want to change and the landscape that will stay.

blocks.h2: Change the part that is hardest to use.
paras: A patch beside the patio, a dog’s route or a putting line can define a useful project without replacing all the planting. Mark trees, roots and irrigation before the old lawn comes out. Include any low spots and the route for materials in the visit.
For a green, choose the putts you want and leave room to stand and walk. For pets, consider cleanup access and shade alongside the turf boundary.

blocks.h2: Use the parcel, not the mailing label.
paras: Ask Arapahoe County about the actual scope if the proposal includes grading, drainage or other landscape changes. Check any recorded property or association requirements as well.
Use the provider on your water bill when comparing ongoing costs. A nearby Denver program should not be assumed to apply simply because the address is written the same way.
